effects: The signer sends msg.value of native ETH to the WETH contract.
The signer's WETH balance rises by exactly msg.value (balanceOf[msg.sender] += msg.value), 1:1, with no fee.
formats.shown: "Wrap" with one field, Amount = the native value sent (e.g. 0.00187 ETH).

findings.title: deposit(): intent 'Wrap' does not name the token received or the amount, and there is no interpolatedIntent.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json display.formats["deposit()"]: intent "Wrap", no interpolatedIntent; WETH9.sol deposit(): balanceOf[msg.sender] += msg.value. Case 0 reader: 'The WETH amount received isn't shown'.
findings.fix: Add interpolatedIntent "Wrap {amount} ETH into WETH" (or intent "Wrap ETH into WETH") so the 1:1 WETH credit is stated.

cases.notes: Mined tx: 0.00187 ETH out from signer to WETH and 0.00187 WETH credited to signer. The screen shows the ETH amount, and 'Wrap' on the WETH contract implies the 1:1 WETH credit. The reader inferred the WETH credit correctly but was unsure because the token is not named.
